CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW torre.gold_v_projecao_mes_atual AS
WITH
-- Passo 1: total real por dia nos últimos 30 dias (todas filiais somadas)
run_rate_diario AS (
  SELECT
    data,
    eh_dia_util,
    SUM(total_valor_liquido) AS total_dia
  FROM torre.gold_mv_kpis_combustivel_diario
  WHERE data >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND data < CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY data, eh_dia_util
),
-- Passo 2: média por tipo de dia (útil vs fim de semana)
media_por_tipo AS (
  SELECT
    eh_dia_util,
    AVG(total_dia) AS media_dia
  FROM run_rate_diario
  GROUP BY eh_dia_util
),
-- Passo 3: dias restantes no mês corrente (hoje inclusive até fim do mês)
dias_restantes AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM gs.dt) IN (0, 6) THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS eh_dia_util,
    COUNT(*) AS qtd_dias
  FROM generate_series(
    CURRENT_DATE,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day',
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) AS gs(dt)
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- Passo 4: total já realizado no mês atual
realizado_mes AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(total_valor_liquido), 0) AS total_realizado
  FROM torre.gold_mv_kpis_combustivel_diario
  WHERE ano_mes = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
    AND data < CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')                          AS ano_mes,
  CURRENT_DATE                                               AS data_referencia,
  ROUND(rm.total_realizado::numeric, 2)                      AS realizado_ate_hoje,
  ROUND(SUM(m.media_dia * dr.qtd_dias)::numeric, 2)          AS projecao_restante,
  ROUND((rm.total_realizado
       + SUM(m.media_dia * dr.qtd_dias))::numeric, 2)        AS projecao_fechamento,
  -- Dias restantes detalhados
  SUM(dr.qtd_dias) FILTER (WHERE dr.eh_dia_util)             AS dias_uteis_restantes,
  SUM(dr.qtd_dias) FILTER (WHERE NOT dr.eh_dia_util)         AS dias_fds_restantes,
  ROUND(m_util.media_dia::numeric, 2)                        AS media_dia_util,
  ROUND(m_fds.media_dia::numeric, 2)                         AS media_dia_fds
FROM dias_restantes dr
JOIN media_por_tipo m ON m.eh_dia_util = dr.eh_dia_util
CROSS JOIN realizado_mes rm
CROSS JOIN (SELECT media_dia FROM media_por_tipo WHERE eh_dia_util = TRUE)  m_util
CROSS JOIN (SELECT media_dia FROM media_por_tipo WHERE eh_dia_util = FALSE) m_fds
GROUP BY rm.total_realizado, m_util.media_dia, m_fds.media_dia;

SELECT 'View gold_v_projecao_mes_atual criada' AS status;

SELECT
  ano_mes,
  data_referencia,
  realizado_ate_hoje,
  projecao_restante,
  projecao_fechamento,
  dias_uteis_restantes,
  dias_fds_restantes,
  media_dia_util,
  media_dia_fds
FROM torre.gold_v_projecao_mes_atual;
